card.name: The ending of "momentous"
card.fires_on: The ending "ous" in the word "momentous" (moment + ous), in general prose about historic events, years or consequences. Other word endings fire only weakly.

modes.label: momentous ending
modes.description: The "ous" piece completing "momentous" before a noun like consequences, years or event.
